projects.title: TripScript — Multilingual Trip Planner
projects.description: TripScript is a modern trip planner that lets users search places, add multi-stop routes and visualize them on an interactive map. It features debounced search via the Photon API, a stops list with coordinates and easy removal, a Leaflet-powered map and a route summary using Haversine distance. Built with the Next.js App Router, TypeScript and Tailwind, with i18n through next-intl and a mock mode powered by MSW for smooth local development.

projects.title: NextAI Chatbot
projects.description: A Chatbot combining the robustness of Next.js, the intelligence of OpenAI, and the aesthetics of Tailwind CSS, all deployed via Vercel. Designed to deliver a conversational experience that's smooth, natural, and engaging, it utilizes OpenAI's language models to understand context and generate replies, providing users with a taste of the future of human-computer interaction.

projects.title: Meowify - Chrome Extension
projects.description: Meowify is a whimsical Chrome extension that transforms the text of any webpage into 'meow,' mimicking the language of cats. This project was designed to provide a humorous and engaging way to interact with web content, instantly altering text upon a single click. Key features include toggling between original text and 'meowified' text, ensuring a reversible, fun browsing experience. The extension employs minimal permissions to enhance user security and was developed using modern web technologies, including HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

projects.title: Interactive Product page with GSAP and Three.js
projects.description: This project was an in-depth journey into creating highly interactive and visually appealing web experiences using GSAP (GreenSock Animation Platform) for animations and Three.js for 3D modeling. Key features: Implementing complex animations with GSAP, integrating 3D models seamlessly into web pages, setting up Sentry for error logging and mastering the art of crafting engaging UI sections such as products, hero sections, highlights, video carousels, and more!

projects.title: Ajar PropTech Platform Overhaul and Enhancement
projects.description: At Ajar, a pioneering PropTech firm in the Middle East, I took the helm of frontend development to institute major platform overhauls and innovatively integrate new features. I completely reconstructed the landing pages using Angular and Bootstrap, which directly translated into a 30% uptick in user engagement. I optimized the login and sign-up processes, added robust features like expense management and report downloading, and revamped the leases management system. Furthermore, I championed the migration from Firebase APIs to REST APIs, improving backend data handling and overall platform responsiveness. As a testament to my adaptability, I seamlessly transitioned from React to Angular within a tight two-month window. In collaboration with marketing initiatives, I drove the implementation of Facebook and Snapchat tracking pixels, culminating in a notable 20% increase in high-value clients. By incorporating automated test cases using Playwright with GitHub workflows, I advanced the deployment process, ensuring faster release cycles, a heightened code quality, and a 35% reduction in bug resolution time. Throughout, I maintained the brand's graphic consistency and high-quality standards, further elevating the platform's user experience.

projects.title: Tenant Dashboard Solution
projects.description: Designed a comprehensive tenant dashboard prototype to assist newcomers in the MENA property market. The dashboard provides an overview of rent payments, maintenance requests, and essential property documentation. Tenants also gain insights into regional news and can efficiently manage work order requests, receipt histories, and critical document storage. Integrated Auth0 for secure login and Ant Design for a scalable UI. The responsive design ensures a seamless experience across devices.

projects.title: GitHub Trending Page Replica
projects.description: Developed a replica of the GitHub trending page to understand the intricacies of popular repositories' display. Leveraged React for UI components, Tailwind for styling, and efficiently fetched data with react query and axios.

projects.title: Jungle E-commerce Webshop
projects.description: Built an interactive e-commerce SPA using Commerce.js and React. Seamlessly integrated Stripe for payments and used React Hook Forms for efficient customer data management. Styled using Material UI.

projects.title: Intuitive Expense Tracker
projects.description: Crafted a user-friendly expense tracker in React. Users can seamlessly log expenses, filter by year, and visualize data through an intuitive bar chart. Achieved efficient initial rendering with CRA.

projects.title: Gourmet Recipe Viewer
projects.description: Designed an elegant recipe viewer with Gatsby and Contentful. Users can effortlessly explore recipes through tags or a dedicated list. Each recipe page offers detailed instructions, serving sizes, and necessary cooking appliances.

projects.title: Rick and Morty Character Showcase
projects.description: Crafted a fun SPA with Vite, giving fans of the show a chance to discover random characters and their backstories. Developed using Typescript and React and brought to life with Tailwind styling.

projects.title: Dynamic Food Ordering Interface
projects.description: Developed a dynamic food ordering SPA. Showcased dishes from an API based on inventory and discounts. Enhanced user experience by preserving cart data using local storage. Styled with React and Tailwind.

projects.title: Facial Recognition Interface
projects.description: Incorporated Clarifai API into a SPA to detect faces in uploaded images. Users can register and track their photo scan count. Backed by a robust server infrastructure using Node.js, Express.js, and PostgressSQL.

projects.title: Elegant Image Gallery
projects.description: Merged React's efficiency with Tailwind's styling to build a stunning image gallery. Users can search and view images sourced from the Pixabay API.

projects.title: Travel Enthusiast Landing Page
projects.description: Designed a fully responsive travel-themed landing page. Developed from scratch, incorporating modern web technologies like Node.js, ES6 JS, webpack, and gulp for an optimized user experience.
